messages.content:
Inspect this flowchart image against the requested process. Identify up to 4 specific mistakes: missing stages, wrong arrow direction or branch, overlapping boxes, unreadable text. Name the visible labels involved. Do not invent an error if the image is unclear. Return a short list of concrete corrections.

Requested process:
Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Follow this exact sequence: "Experiment begins" -> "Prepare sample" -> "Calibrate sensor" -> "Measure sample" -> "Save measurements" -> "Clean equipment" -> "Experiment complete".

response.text: Experiment begins with Prepare sample which is then connected with Calibrate sensor which is then connected with Measure sample which is further connected with Save measurements which is finally connected with Clean equipment. Clean equipment is connected with Experiment complete which is finally connected with Measure sample.
